description_en: Creates an online editing project (video editing task)
description_zh: 调用本接口创建云剪辑工程（视频编辑任务）
name: AddEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The title of the online editing project
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The description of the online editing project
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The timeline of the online editing project. The value is in JSON format. For more information about the structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html.

If this parameter is left empty, an empty timeline is created, and the total duration of the online editing project is 0
parameters.help_zh:
云剪辑工程时间线。JSON格式。具体结构定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html。

当该字段为空时，则创建一个空的时间线，且云剪辑工程的总时长为0
parameters.name: timeline

parameters.help_en: The thumbnail of the online editing project. If this parameter is left empty and materials already exist on the video track of the timeline, the thumbnail of the first material on the timeline is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 云剪辑工程封面。如果为空且时间线上的video轨已经存在素材，则默认选取时间线上第一个素材封面
parameters.name: cover_url

Project.description_en: The online editing project. For more information about the structure, see [EditingProject]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）
Project.description_zh: 云剪辑工程。具体结构定义，请参见[EditingProject]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was created. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the online editing project

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was last modified. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project

Status.description_en:
The status of the online editing project. Valid values:

Normal: draft
Producing: producing
Produced: produced
ProduceFailed: production failed
Status.description_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。取值：

Normal：草稿。
Producing：合成中。
Produced：合成成功。
ProduceFailed：合成失败

Title.description_en: The title of the online editing project
